articles.title: Can America Afford Medicare for All—or Can We Afford to Keep the System We Have?
articles.description: An evidence-based look at U.S. healthcare spending, insurance costs, administrative waste, and the potential trade-offs of Medicare for All. Savings depend on the specific plan and assumptions.

articles.title: Obamacare vs. Medicare for All: The Difference Between Having Insurance and Affording Healthcare
